extracted.name: Chef John's Green Goddess Dressing
extracted.description: This green goddess dressing recipe makes a delicious creamy salad dressing flavored with parsley, tarragon, chives, lemon, garlic, and rice vinegar.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, or more to taste
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Process mayonnaise, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, lemon juice, rice wine vinegar, anchovy fillet, garlic, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper in a blender until smooth and pale green, about 30 seconds.
